findings.claim: CheckPolicy's unresolvable-base fallback trusts the unverified working-copy policy's Mode, so a deleted/absent policy.json plus a base-resolution failure yields a silent pass instead of the hard error required by the plan's D10 and the code's own invariant.
findings.fix: Fail closed on an unresolvable base — treat it as gated/strict (or always hard-error) regardless of the local file's claimed mode, add a TestCheckPolicyUnresolvableBaseWithDeletedWorkingFile case, or explicitly document the accepted risk.

findings.claim: GitChangedFiles splits git diff --name-only / git ls-files output with strings.Fields, so filenames containing spaces are broken into bogus fragments and their rule-delta checks are silently dropped.
findings.fix: Split on newlines instead (git outputs one path per line), e.g. strings.Split with TrimSuffix and an empty-string filter.

findings.claim: The four default 'ask' gate entries for Edit/Write on **/*.acdsl and acdsl/** were removed from smine's own settings.json without any plan calling for it, stripping the only guard on ACDSL rule-file edits in a repo the new policy hook leaves ungated (mode free).
findings.fix: Get an explicit confirm-or-revert: restore the four Edit/Write entries, or durably record the deliberate decision to drop them (plan Changelog row, context fact, or explanatory commit message).

findings.claim: Railroad-review's lane-context model was reversed from the approved plan (v8.3's --no-context opt-out replaced by v8.4's forced full doctrine injection via skill-invoke-gate.sh) without any entry in the plan document's own Changelog, leaving the plan misrepresenting the shipped design.
findings.fix: Update the plan's Changelog with the v8.4 pivot and its rationale, or note in the plan that it was superseded by a later decision.

findings.claim: GitRevParse is exported but has no production caller — it is only used from its own test file.
findings.fix: Use it where GitMergeBase/manual git rev-parse calls are duplicated, or drop the export and inline the one test call site.

findings.claim: classViolations rebuilds a fresh editable map from policy.EditableScopes on every call (three times per CheckPolicy invocation), a needless O(n) rebuild if ever called from a hot path.

The dev_mode/orchestrate/auto_apply derivation block reads the presentation profile three separate times via sed with precedence rules threaded through shell variables, forcing future readers to re-derive env > profile > default precedence from the code.
findings.fix: Add a short 'precedence: env > profile > default' table comment.
